Return Policy
We do not offer returns based on taste preferences or change of heart. However, if you experience a problem with your order, please let us know within 7 days of the delivery date.
When reporting an issue, include:
Your order number
An explanation of the issue
A photo of the package and contents where the issue is clearly visible
EU Exception: Orders placed via the EU Flaviar website (https://eu.flaviar.com/) can be returned within 14 days from the delivery date according to EU regulations. You are responsible for the costs of postage and packaging.
Cancellation & Refund Policy
You can cancel an order for a full refund within three days of purchase, provided it has not shipped yet. Once tracking information becomes available, cancellation is no longer possible.
Non-Refundable Items
The following cannot be returned or refunded:
Personalized items (e.g., engraved products)
Pre-orders
Special releases
Seasonal products (such as the Whiskey Advent Calendar)
Returned Shipments
